config.description: Configarr's `config.yml`, as a string: Configarr's `!env`, `!secret` and `!file` tags would be dropped silently in a values map. Copied verbatim into a ConfigMap; the chart checks that it parses as a YAML mapping. The default `{}` syncs nothing. Never write API keys here: use `!env` with `extraEnv`, or `!secret` with `secrets.existingSecret`.

options.description: DNS options (fewer search-list lookups for external host names such as github.com; Service names need their namespace or FQDN).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables (`EnvVar` list) for the Configarr container: the variables `!env` tags read (API keys from a Secret by `secretKeyRef`), `LOG_LEVEL`, `LOG_FORMAT`, `DRY_RUN`, `CONFIGARR_ENABLE_MERGE`, `TZ`. `CONFIGARR_ENFORCE_CONFIG_VALIDATION` (the chart sets `true`: a typo in `config` fails the run) is overridden by this list. Names the chart sets are rejected: `STOP_ON_ERROR`, `CONFIG_LOCATION`, `SECRETS_LOCATION`, `ROOT_PATH`, `CUSTOM_REPO_ROOT`. Names are case-sensitive.

extraInitContainers.description: Extra init containers, rendered as given. The Configarr image has no shell: use another image.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the Configarr container.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes: local custom formats and templates (`localCustomFormatsPath`, `localConfigTemplatesPath`, conventionally `/app/cfs` and `/app/templates`), files read by `!file`.

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.

hostUsers.description: Run the pod in a user namespace (`false`: uid 65532 maps to an unprivileged host uid). Needs node support (containerd 2.0+ or CRI-O, runc 1.2+, kernel 6.3+) and idmapped mounts on every volume's file system (not NFS/SMB); pods fail to start otherwise. `true` uses host users.

digest.description: Image digest, only valid together with `image.tag`.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty: the tag and digest recorded for `image.repository` in the `artifacthub.io/images` annotation of `Chart.yaml`. When set, the chart digest is not applied; add `image.digest` to pin it.

nameOverride.description:
yaml-language-server: $schema=values.schema.json
Override the chart name used in resource names and labels.

to.description: DNS peers (port 53 TCP/UDP). Override for NodeLocal DNSCache or non-standard labels.

enabled.description: Restrict egress (DNS, GitHub for the TRaSH-Guides and Recyclarr repositories, `extraEgress`).

extraEgress.description: Extra `NetworkPolicyEgressRule`s: Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr (they are in the private ranges `peers` excludes).

to.description: GitHub and other internet hosts (any port). Default: the internet, not the private, CGNAT and link-local ranges, so a compromised process cannot move sideways.

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy. Ingress: none (the pod has no port).

accessModes.description: Access modes of the chart's PVC. `ReadWriteOnce` is enough: `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid` runs one Job at a time.

enabled.description: Keep the TRaSH-Guides and Recyclarr clones (`/app/repos`) in a PersistentVolumeClaim between runs. `false`: an `emptyDir`, each run clones again.

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC to use when `enabled`. Empty: the chart creates one (deleted on uninstall: it is a cache).

storageClassName.description: StorageClass of the chart's PVC. Empty: the cluster default.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. Overrides are merged onto these defaults.

resources.description: Resources of the Configarr container. No CPU limit on purpose.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the sync, in the time zone of kube-controller-manager (usually UTC). Each run reverts what `config` manages.

key.description: Key of the Secret holding the `secrets.yml` content.

name.description: Secret holding Configarr's `secrets.yml` (the values of `!secret` tags), mounted at `/app/config/secrets.yml`. Empty: none, and a `!secret` tag in `config` fails the install.

securityContext.description: Container security context of the Configarr container (read-only root filesystem: it writes only to the `/app/repos` volume). Overrides are merged onto these defaults.

name.description: ServiceAccount name. Empty: `<fullname>` (or `default` when `create` is false).
